title: FBI-UAP-D015, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 1-2, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering and narrative statement created by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2023 UAP sighting reported by a federal law enforcement agent.

incidents.summary: A federal law enforcement special agent reported observing a large, glowing orange-red circular object and three smaller red lights in a vertical column near a sensitive national security site.
